description: This Java class 'FeatureCreatedStrategy' implements an event handling strategy for 'FeatureCreated' events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy class and applies the event to modify a 'ThingBuilder' instance by setting a feature.

classes.name: FeatureCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles 'FeatureCreated' events by applying changes to 'ThingBuilder' instances.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process 'FeatureCreated' events, setting the feature in the 'ThingBuilder'.
